original.statement: The storage version of clusterexternalsecrets.external-secrets.io changes from v1beta1 to v1 (in chart 0.16.0 the CRD no longer marks v1beta1 as storage, true → false), so existing ClusterExternalSecret objects stay stored as v1beta1 until a storage version migration (re-write all objects) is run and status.storedVersions is updated, which must happen before a later release removes v1beta1.

corrected.statement: The storage version of clusterexternalsecrets.external-secrets.io changes from v1beta1 to v1. Environments with any ClusterExternalSecret objects, whatever apiVersion their manifests use, keep them stored as v1beta1. They must run a storage version migration and update status.storedVersions before v1beta1 is removed.

decision.reason: [ev-a93bb3b1d26d] shows the storage version of the ClusterExternalSecret CRD moving from v1beta1 to v1 (v1beta1 storage changes from true to false). The change text says that *existing* ClusterExternalSecret objects stay stored as v1beta1 until they are rewritten, and that status.storedVersions must be updated. The storage version is stored per object and per CRD, whatever apiVersion the manifests use. So a predicate that only matches manifests written as v1beta1 is too narrow: it misses environments that have ClusterExternalSecret objects but whose manifests already use v1 (which only exists in the target release, per the validator on [ev-9889c9b8706d] and [ev-e08924afdc47]) or another served version. Exposure should therefore be any use of the ClusterExternalSecret kind, with no version.
